description: This file contains functions to retrieve and display the top sales orders in a list view, including generating queries, handling custom views, and preparing data for display in a SugarCRM module.

methods.name: getTopSalesOrder
methods.description: Retrieves top sales orders based on specified maximum entries, constructs list view with headers and entries, handles pagination and custom views.

methods.name: getTopSalesOrderSearch
methods.description: Builds search criteria for retrieving sales orders due today and assigned to current user, encodes criteria in JSON.
